fusions.name: Stitch Bites
fusions.desc: Three quick strikes, each dealing 6 damage and making the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Spring on the Line
fusions.desc: You rush to the target along a tether and strike it for 14 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchored Leap
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away and gives you +15% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Slack Taken Up
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 12 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
